True def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    marker = max((v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != bg), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        for r in (r0, r1):
            if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in (c0, c1):
            if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = 2
    return out
